import unittest
from subject import total


class TotalTests(unittest.TestCase):
    # 判準來源：題述規格；(2,False)=40、(3,False)=70 為已確認例子

    def test_confirmed_examples(self):
        self.assertEqual(total(2, False), 40)
        self.assertEqual(total(3, False), 70)

    def test_light_band_boundaries(self):
        # 0..2 -> 40；抓下界/上界 off-by-one
        self.assertEqual(total(0, False), 40)
        self.assertEqual(total(2, False), 40)

    def test_mid_band_boundaries(self):
        # 3..5 -> 70
        self.assertEqual(total(3, False), 70)
        self.assertEqual(total(5, False), 70)

    def test_heavy_band(self):
        # >=6 -> 100；抓 6 誤歸 70 或重件固定回傳 70
        self.assertEqual(total(6, False), 100)
        self.assertEqual(total(50, False), 100)

    def test_remote_adds_20_each_band(self):
        # 抓忽略 remote 或加錯金額
        self.assertEqual(total(2, True), 60)
        self.assertEqual(total(3, True), 90)
        self.assertEqual(total(6, True), 120)

    def test_negative_weight_rejected_with_reason(self):
        # 抓缺守衛或錯誤理由
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "^invalid-weight$"):
            total(-1, False)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "^invalid-weight$"):
            total(-1, True)
